title: Down Payment, Regular Installment and First Due Date of a New Plan
content:
Patient Financial Services calculation note on the figures of a new **Patient Payment Plans** offer: the down payment, the regular installment, the minimum-installment test and the date of installment 1.

## The clauses

**Down payment.** The down payment is the term's down-payment percentage of the enrolled balance, rounded to the cent, and it is due at acceptance. A term whose percentage is zero carries no down payment.

**Regular installment.** The regular installment is the enrolled balance less the down payment, divided by the term's number of monthly installments and rounded to the cent; the last installment absorbs the rounding difference.

**Minimum installment.** When the regular installment is below the term's smallest regular installment, that term cannot be offered and a shorter term is used. The test reads the balance due of the invoices to be enrolled as the company's invoice records show it.

**Due day and installment 1.** The patient picks a due day between the term's earliest and latest due day. Installment 1 falls on that day in the first month at least the term's "days to installment 1" calendar days after the offer date, and never later than the term's "installment 1 no later than" number of days after it.

**No interest and no setup fee.** Plans carry no interest and no setup fee.

## Worked figures (hypothetical offers)

**Offer on a 12-month term.** Enrolled balance 1,250.00; down-payment percentage 10.
- Down payment: 10 percent of 1,250.00 is 125.00, due at acceptance.
- Regular installment: 1,250.00 less 125.00 is 1,125.00; divided by 12 that is 93.75.
- Minimum test: 93.75 is not below the term's smallest installment, so the term can be offered.

**Offer on a 3-month term with rounding.** Enrolled balance 200.00; no down payment.
- 200.00 divided by 3 is 66.666…, rounded to the cent 66.67.
- Installments 1 and 2 are 66.67 each; installment 3 absorbs the difference and is 66.66, so the three total 200.00.

**Minimum test failing.** Enrolled balance 1,000.00 on an 18-month term with a down-payment percentage of 10 and a smallest installment of 55.00.
- Down payment 100.00; 900.00 divided by 18 is 50.00.
- 50.00 is below 55.00, so the 18-month term cannot be offered and a shorter term is used.

## Placing installment 1 (hypothetical dates)

Offer date 20 March; "days to installment 1" of 30 and "no later than" of 45, as an illustration.

| Due day chosen | First date on that day at least 30 days after the offer | Days after the offer | Within 45 days |
|---|---|---|---|
| 25th | 25 April | 36 | Yes |
| 19th | 19 April | 30 (exactly the minimum) | Yes |
| 3rd | 3 May (3 April is only 14 days after) | 44 | Yes |
| 18th | 18 May (18 April is only 29 days after) | 59 | No — this due day does not satisfy the clause for that offer date |

A due day of the 29th, 30th or 31st is outside the range every term allows.
